name: library_edit
description: Edit a library asset you can manage (`manage: true` in `library_list`, which includes team-managed assets you do not own) — character/product/location — by numeric `id`. Partial update: send only fields to change. Optionally replace `cover` and/or `images` (reference set). No LoRA/variants/sheet regen.

description.description: New description, max 1000. Empty string clears it.

id.description: Numeric library asset id (from library_create / library_list).

images.description: Replace the reference image set (1-6 JPEG/PNG/WebP).
